The 'stars' and 'forks' values must be integers that correspond to the star and fork counts explicitly attached to the project in the input text, and must not be confused with other numbers such as open issues, watchers, contributors, or dates (e.g., 0 open issues must not be reported as stars).

features.name: raw_similarity
features.description: token overlap of the raw records

features.name: cve_year_sequence_pair
features.description: Extracts the year and sequence number of a CVE-style identifier, with or without the 'CVE' prefix and with any separator (-, :, ., _), so records that encode the same CVE in different formats still align. This separates true matches, where the year-number pair agrees despite noisy surrounding tokens, from non-matches that merely share digits or tokens.

features.name: confusable_digit_sequence
features.description: Recovers a CVE-like sequence number from noisy tokens where digits are replaced by look-alike letters (O→0, Z→2, l/I→1, S→5, B→8) and separators are interleaved, so a true match still aligns when the year-number pair is not cleanly parseable by the existing rule.

features.name: normalized_cve_year
features.description: Extracts the publication year that accompanies a CVE-like token, after mapping look-alike characters back to digits and expanding two-digit years to four digits (e.g. 24 becomes 2024). Comparing years on their own separates hard cases that share a sequence-number-like digit run but come from different years, and it still works when the sequence number is too noisy to parse.

features.name: bare_sequence_candidate
features.description: Captures the longest digit run of 4 to 7 characters after look-alike mapping, with separators removed and leading zeros stripped, so a shared sequence number still aligns when the CVE prefix or year is missing, split by punctuation, or buried in other tokens.
